messages:
jess: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the cross-region routing flap + TLS oscillation. Root cause looked like a route reprogramming race that exposed a cert handshake retry storm. Posting action items; please ack and add ETA.

1) Ensure route program + reconcile ordering prevents transient dual-edges (owner: mike) - target: 2026-04-02
2) Add deterministic backoff to TLS handshake retry logic in the LB client (owner: sanjay) - target: 2026-03-30
3) Add synthetic probe to detect cross-region handshake error amplification (owner: kim) - target: 2026-03-28
4) Runbook entry: 'cross-region tls retry storm' with mitigation steps and rollback commands (owner: jess) - target: 2026-03-26

mike: ack. i'll take #1. trying to reproduce the reconcile race locally today, will push a small reorder patch if it reproduces.

sanjay: ack. i'll prototype jittered exponential backoff and a cap on in-flight handshakes. thinking: start=50ms, factor=2, cap=2s.

kim: ack probe. i'll add a healthcheck that simulates 10 concurrent cross-region handshakes and alerts on >5% error amplification. will wire into datadog.

jess: perfect. notes:
- priority: reduce blast radius for next 48h by soft-failing to fallback region when handshake error rate spikes >1%
- rolling canary: apply reorder patch to one region, monitor for 30m.

mike: question: do we want the soft-fail policy behind a feature flag? i can gate it and roll with a 1-region canary.

jess: yes, gate it. name: feature/soft-fail-cross-region-tls. mike -> add to PR description and canary playbook.

sanjay: quick note - we should limit retries at the client and not the LB alone; some customers use our LB as passthrough so retries multiply. i'll add a short patch to our client lib and post a compat note.

kim: probe snippet i'm planning to add:
```
POST /probe/cross-region-handshake
{ "concurrency": 10, "iterations": 50, "target_region": "eu-west-1" }
```
Alert when avg error amplification > 3x baseline.

jess: oncall-bot will create a recurring check for the next 2 weeks to surface regressions. Also i'll own the runbook and coordinate SRE review.

oncall-bot: Created incident followup ticket INF-4821 assigned to jess, mike, sanjay, kim. Next check-in scheduled 2026-03-29 15:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rolling canary created: region=us-west-2, tag=route-reconcile-reorder.v1, started=2801234600. Monitor: /dashboards/routing-canary.

mike: pushed draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3421 - includes reorder + unit tests. requesting review from @sanjay and @kim.

sanjay: reviewing now. adding a performance test to ensure no latency regressions from reorder.

jess: thanks all. please update this thread when you hit your targets or need help. if anyone can't meet ETA, ping me ASAP so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
